name: rajtally
description: Read, report on and post to Tally.ERP 9 / TallyPrime from chat.

interface.shortDescription: Read, report on and post to Tally
interface.longDescription: Connects to Tally.ERP 9 or TallyPrime running on your computer. Read ledgers, vouchers and stock; get trial balance, balance sheet, profit and loss, outstandings, GST and TDS working papers, bank reconciliation and audit checks; create and edit masters, vouchers and GST invoices with a dry-run preview and access levels.
defaultPrompt: @RAJ Tally FINL check the Tally connection and show the trial balance.
